products.title: Rambler Fleck Sweater
products.body_html: Step up your sweater game with our fresh spin on our classic knit crew. Made from 100% organic cotton yarn with a contrast nep, it delivers a unique touch of texture and color.

products.title: Chilton Parka
products.body_html: Combining the warmth of a puffer with the coverage of a parka, this jacket will keep you warm on winter’s coldest days. It’s made from recycled materials and coated with a DWR finish to keep you dry and outside.

products.title: Quilted Reynard Crew
products.body_html: Same Reynard fit, now in a soft, diamond-quilted fabric for extra texture and warmth — perfect for that “I’m not stopping just because it’s winter” kind of energy.

products.title: Nimbus Rain Jacket
products.body_html: For those days when the rain won't quit, there's this sustainably made waterproof jacket — with fully taped seams and a non-toxic, DWR finish.

products.title: Juniper Zip Hoodie
products.body_html: Featuring our ever popular signature Juniper graphic, the Juniper zip up hoodie sets the sustainable standard in comfortable daily wear.

products.title: Brewster Vest
products.body_html: Whether you're layering up for an outdoor adventure or crafting the perfect look for an evening out with friends, this earth-friendly vest can do it all.

products.title: Boulder Vest
products.body_html: Wear it on its own or as an extra warm layer under coats and jackets — this lightweight vest features technical details that make it perfect for anything, whatever your winter plans.

products.title: Palisade Full Zip
products.body_html: A full zip microfleece that’s full of features that elevate your everyday. Add this super soft piece to your mid-layer collection — your adventure plans will thank you.

products.title: Coastal Hybrid Hoodie
products.body_html: Stay dry and sustainable in this water-resistant hoodie-jacket hybrid, made from 100% recycled polyester. It doesn’t get much more planet-friendly (or snug) than this.

products.title: Livingston Jacket
products.body_html: Get wrapped up in the cozy durability of our long plaid jacket. Made from organic cotton, this classic button-up is your perfect companion for all your fall adventures.
